title: Glaphyra Book 1 Cain and Abel opening
english: The brothers’ offerings and the accepted sacrifice are read so that Christ’s accepted offering is foreshadowed, without canceling the historia.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Lunn FOTC wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
